messages:
ira: Need one-pager decisions for private-deploy launch: default network mode, upgrade default, telemetry opt-in flow, and a short customer note.

sam: Recommend default = relay (operator bundle). NAT for egress preservation as opt-in. BGP is advanced, SE-assisted.

celeste: For upgrades default to rolling canary (configurable). Canary 5% for 10m, auto-abort on failed smoke checks. Blue/green documented as advanced.

otto: Telemetry default OFF. Provide `redwoodctl telemetry consent --scopes=errors,perf` which returns a signed token for audit. `redwoodctl install --preflight-only --output=json` for automation.

ira: Draft customer blurb: "Default installer uses relay to avoid routing changes. If you need preserved egress IPs, select NAT or contact SE for BGP. Rolling upgrades minimize disruption; plan for 15-60m. Telemetry is opt-in."

ops-bot: Created ticket PD-20456 "private-deploy launch defaults & consent" assigned to @ira @sam @celeste @otto.
thread_text_summary: Short alignment: relay default, NAT opt-in, BGP enterprise add-on; rolling canary upgrades with auto-abort; telemetry default off with consent token; action owners and ticket created
